# Report Outline (PDF, ≤ 8 pages excluding references and appendix)

The structure is exactly the one the assignment PDF asks for. The page budget adds up to 8. Write in LaTeX (an IEEE two-column template fits a lot in 8 pages) or Google Docs exported to PDF.
**Every number comes from `results/`. Every figure is generated by `scripts/make_plots.py`.**

| § | Section (from PDF) | Pages | Must contain |
|---|---|---|---|
| — | Title, team, track, links (repo, video) | 0.2 | "LipiSetu: Script-Invariant Hindi Search", T5, repo URL, unlisted video URL |
| 1 | **Problem and track relevance** | 0.8 | User need (Roman-script Hindi users get worse search); the Script Gap defined in one sentence; why it's a T5 theme; **papers referred** (list in `PLAN.md` §1), especially Gupta et al. SIGIR 2014 and FIRE MSIR as closest prior work |
| 2 | **How we used IR** | 2.0 | **Pipeline diagram** (figure); one paragraph + formula per principle: normalisation and tokenisation (with the `\w` matra pitfall), stop words + idf behaviour on Hindi (E3 plot), stemmer (E2), positional index + phrase, Boolean with df ordering, tf-idf lnc.ltc, BM25 with zones, **Dhvani key** (rule table + examples), pooled df (formula), heap top-K, champion lists. **Where in the code** (short file paths) and **why each was chosen**. Library roles in IR terms (table from `docs/IR_CONCEPTS.md`). |
| 3 | **Beyond IR** | 0.8 | Dense e5-small (int8 ONNX), RRF, the gated cascade (features = query performance prediction signals, logistic gate trained on train), SCD + vocabulary pruning if done. How each one **supports** the IR side rather than replacing it. |
| 4 | **Novelty and creativity** | 0.7 | Table "obvious baseline (B2) vs. LipiSetu" (from `PLAN.md` §2.1–2.2); N1–N6; the **honest prior-art paragraph** (`PLAN.md` §2.3) |
| 5 | **Evaluation** | 2.0 | Setup (splits, forms, systems, metrics with formulas incl. RBO); Table A (effectiveness), Table B (invariance), Table C (efficiency); figures: Script Gap bar chart, budget curve (E7), annotator variation (E10); significance results; the P@10 ceiling note |
| 6 | **Limitations and next steps + roadmap** | 0.8 | At least: subsampled corpus; unjudged = non-relevant; synthetic romanisation and mixed corpus; Dhvani collisions (with numbers); Hindi only; small human set. **Course-project roadmap:** more languages (MIRACL bn/te), voice queries, ONNX Runtime Web on-device demo, larger human set, neural transliteration comparison, a write-up for FIRE |
| 7 | **Work division** | 0.3 | From `docs/WORK_DIVISION.md` ("what actually happened") |
| — | **AI-use declaration** | 0.4 | From `docs/AI_USE.md` |
| — | References | (not counted) | Every paper, dataset and model |
| — | Appendix | (not counted) | Full Dhvani mapping table, extra result tables, sample `--explain` output |

## Figures to produce (via `scripts/make_plots.py`)
1. Pipeline diagram (draw.io or TikZ; it can be adapted from the ASCII diagram in `PLAN.md` §3)
2. Script Gap per system (grouped bars by query form)
3. Budget curve: nDCG@10 vs. % neural calls (gate vs. random vs. extremes)
4. Zipf plot + idf histogram for the Hindi corpus (E3)
5. Annotator variation: distribution of spellings per word (E10)

## Writing checklist
- [ ] Each IR principle names its **file path** and **why** it was chosen
- [ ] No claim of "first" or "state of the art"; "to our knowledge" where needed
- [ ] Every number matches `results/*.csv`
- [ ] ≤ 8 pages before references
- [ ] Repo and video links work in an incognito window
